children: 3SBio reported Phase II data for tivunatamig (PF-08634404/SSGJ-707) plus chemo in first-line advanced NSCLC, showing median PFS of 13.6 months in squamous and 13.8 months in non-squamous, with ORR of 80.7% and 77.5% vs controls, and safety broadly comparable to control.
Suggests a clinically meaningful efficacy delta that could support Phase III success and future revenue.
High response rates vs controls (67.7%, 44.7%) indicate strong activity across histologies.
Early molecular response correlated with mPFS 16.4m vs 9.6m, a potential biomarker edge.
Efficacy gain without new Grade 5 TRAEs reduces risk of safety-driven setbacks.
Global partner with 11 trials, >1,500 sites boosts probability of rapid development.

This is mid-stage efficacy confirmation, extending earlier signals with longer follow-up in Phase II. A positive, well-powered Phase III readout and regulatory filings would convert the signal into a major commercial catalyst.
Based on the original press release from 3SBio Inc. distributed by PR Newswire.
